obligations: Specify mathematical semantics, shape constraints, dtype, strides/layout, aliasing and mutation rules.
Specify accumulation precision, tolerances, NaN/Inf behavior and deterministic requirements before optimization.
Decompose by computation primitives and data dependencies: map, reduction, scan, gather/scatter, tiling, synchronization. Select only applicable primitives.
Obtain hardware/compiler/runtime facts from supplied configuration or measured environment; do not assume device names, bandwidth, vector width or remote hosts.
Establish a simple correct reference and independently verified implementation before optimizing.
Measure traffic, work, launch/synchronization costs and bottlenecks. Change one optimization at a time, recheck correctness and compare repeated timings.
checks: Independent reference comparison across normal, boundary and randomized inputs
Non-contiguous layouts and tail sizes when allowed by the declared contract
Numeric error distribution using a trusted checker, not a candidate-produced PASSED string
Memory/race checks supported by the target tooling
Reproducible warmup, synchronization, benchmark inputs and baseline; report spread as well as central latency

seed_policy.reuse: Check every precondition against the new task; mismatch requires adaptation and fresh verification. A similar name is not compatibility.
